decisions.reason: The caption-specific white-text and no-text-effects rules are independently established by another clause in the same message. The source modification adds animations to the general visual-treatment prohibition and does not require changing the caption requirement.
Prohibiting animations and flashy visual treatments does not change the independently stated requirement to use the exact brand-guideline font.
The general visual-effects restriction does not change the substantive requirement to select moments that teach something or provide a lesson.
Removing animations and flashy transitions does not alter the separate completeness and standalone-understandability standards.
The visual-treatment change does not alter the assigned count or the existing same-message instruction to redo and resubmit all eight clips.
The prohibition on animations and flashy transitions concerns editing treatment, not which source material or source video may be selected.
The source modification changes visual editing constraints but does not modify the requirement for clip-opening hook quality.
The visual-effects restriction does not change the existing 20-to-120-second duration limits.
The editing-style modification does not change the monthly target of 180 approved clips or its counting basis.
